title: Copilot Organizational Rollout
problem: A 24-person engineering org had Copilot access but limited adoption. Access alone wasn't producing results.
approach: Built training, usage guidelines, custom team prompts, and ran monthly sharing sessions to establish shared patterns.
outcome: Active usage increased substantially across the team. Code consistency improved before peer review.
leverage: One engineer's workflow changes multiplied across 24 engineers.

title: GeekSuite — AI-Accelerated Delivery
problem: A personal productivity platform spanning multiple apps and services. Traditional solo estimate: 12–18 months.
approach: Used AI for architecture decisions, prototyping, debugging, and iteration — compressing the feedback loop at every stage.
outcome: Core platform delivered in a few months of nights and weekends.
leverage: Solo developer output comparable to a small team.

title: Python Learning Acceleration
problem: Needed working Python proficiency to build validation scripts and automation tools. No existing baseline.
approach: Used AI as tutor, pair programmer, and code reviewer — explaining constructs in real time, not after the fact.
outcome: Reached working proficiency in under 48 hours. Built production-ready tooling on day two.
leverage: Learning cycle compressed from weeks to days.

title: geekPR — Automated Code Review
problem: PR reviews consumed engineering hours on repetitive, low-value checks — lint, style, basic design issues.
approach: Built an automated first-pass review agent to handle static analysis before a human opens the PR.
outcome: Reduced review cycle time. Senior developers now spend review time on logic, not formatting.
leverage: Automated the repetitive. Reserved human attention for what matters.

title: Structured AI Workflow System
problem: AI conversations lost context across sessions, causing regressions and redundant work.
approach: Created a repeatable three-document workflow (THE_CONTEXT.md, THE_PLAN.md, THE_STEPS.md) to maintain durable project memory.
outcome: Consistent outputs across models, sessions, and agents. Work resumable from any state.
leverage: A repeatable process that scales beyond any single AI session or model.
